2609.09776.title: Proof-Carrying Cognition: Closing the Verification Gap with Reality-Settled Reward
2609.09776.paper_summary: Frontier gains in language-model reasoning come from reinforcement learning on reasoning traces and are concentrated in domains with a cheap, sound verifier. We argue the field's binding constraint is the verification gap: no scalable, incorruptible reward for reasoning outside formal domains. We make four contributions. (1) Theory: in a joint-Gaussian model of best-of-N selection, verifier-gold correlation rho is the exact exchange rate between test-time compute and capability, and an unsound verifier pays a polynomial penalty N^(1/rho^2); a margin-free copula form predicts realized soundness of real LLM judges to 4% median error. (2) Demonstration: in program-synthesis testbeds with executable ground truth, including a pre-registered scaled replication, unsound verifiers lose Soundness-under-Pressure as optimization grows (0.94 to 0.32 at N=4096) while a sound verifier improves monotonically; reality-anchored settlement beats a frozen verifier under i.i.d. and adversarial pressure, driving the hacking gap from ~0.27 to ~0; soundness scales log-linearly with settled labels, with on-policy settlement ~10x more label-efficient than random labeling. With real LLM judges and unit-test execution as gold, a weak judge loses soundness under best-of-N (p<0.001), a stronger judge is more robust, and selection alone manufactures +0.53 hacking gaps from honest samples. Under real GRPO training, a frozen reward model traces the full overoptimization curve (executed reward collapses 90%) while the same model refit on a 10% settlement stream preserves 6x the executed reward. (3) Paradigm: proof-carrying cognition, where reasoning steps are typed probabilistic claims priced by a self-built world model trained only on held-out reality and settled by proper scoring rules. (4) Benchmark: we specify Soundness-under-Pressure as the headline metric for a reality-settled reasoning benchmark.
2609.09776.paper_summary_zh: 前沿的語言模型推理進展來自於對推理痕跡的強化學習，並集中在具有廉價且可靠驗證者的領域。我們認為該領域的約束條件是驗證差距：在非正式領域之外，沒有可擴展且不可腐敗的推理獎勵。我們做出四項貢獻。(1) 理論：在最佳選擇的聯合高斯模型中，驗證者-金標的相關性rho是測試時計算與能力之間的確切匯率，而不可靠的驗證者則支付多項式懲罰N^(1/rho^2)；無邊際的共軛形式預測真實LLM評判的實現可靠性，誤差中位數為4%。(2) 示範：在具有可執行真實值的程序合成測試平台中，包括一個預註冊的擴大複製，不可靠的驗證者在優化增長時失去壓力下的可靠性（在N=4096時從0.94降至0.32），而可靠的驗證者則單調改善；現實基礎的結算在獨立同分佈和對抗壓力下超越了凍結的驗證者，將駭客差距從約0.27驅動至約0；可靠性隨著結算標籤呈對數線性擴展，政策內結算的標籤效率約為隨機標籤的10倍。以真實的LLM評判和單元測試執行作為金標，弱評判在最佳選擇下失去可靠性（p<0.001），而強評判則更具魯棒性，僅選擇就能從誠實樣本中製造+0.53的駭客差距。在真實的GRPO訓練下，凍結的獎勵模型描繪了完整的過度優化曲線（執行獎勵崩潰90%），而同一模型在10%的結算流上重新擬合則保留了6倍的執行獎勵。(3) 範式：證明攜帶認知，其中推理步驟是由自建世界模型訓練的類型化概率聲明，僅基於保留的現實並由適當的計分規則結算。(4) 基準：我們將壓力下的可靠性指定為現實結算推理基準的主要指標。
2609.09776.author: Eshwar Reddy M et.al.
